review_candidates.description: Description About Leidos Australia At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life. Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter. Benefits Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes: Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours. Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing. Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities. Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities. Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way. And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive. About The Team You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes. The Mission Software Solutions business delivers customized and off-the-shelf software solutions to Defence, Intelligence and other Government sectors. The business also builds capabilities that can be used for a wide range of applications in both traditional and non-traditional environments; providing leadership in the advancement of technological modernisation of complex enterprises within Government. The Opportunity This is an opportunity for a Senior System Support Analyst to join a high-profile ASD program, providing frontline IT support services across a secure and dynamic operational environment. This role is focused primarily on Service Desk and End User Computing (EUC) support, ensuring users have access to the tools, systems and services they need to perform their roles effectively. Act as a key point of contact for end users, providing first and second-level support across Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, email, remote access, desktop hardware, telephony, peripherals and enterprise applications. Deliver a high-quality support experience by managing incidents and service requests, resolving technical issues, coordinating escalations, and ensuring timely outcomes for customers. Support end-user technology across multiple sites through workstation setup, new starter onboarding, hardware deployments, account administration, software installation, equipment maintenance and lifecycle management activities. Contribute to the ongoing success of a critical ASD capability by maintaining accurate asset records, developing knowledge base articles, supporting vendor and RMA processes, and helping drive continuous improvement across support services. About You To succeed in this role, you will bring a customer-focused approach, a passion for technology, and experience supporting users in a fast-paced IT environment. You enjoy troubleshooting technical issues, providing practical solutions and ensuring customers receive a positive support experience. Essential Experience in a Service Desk, Desktop Support, EUC Support, ICT Support or similar IT support role. Experience troubleshooting Windows 10/11 operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams and related services. Experience providing user account administration, including password resets, account unlocks, group membership changes and access management. Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, printer, peripheral, remote access and connectivity issues. Experience managing incidents and service requests through ServiceNow or a similar IT Service Management (ITSM) platform. Experience deploying, configuring and supporting laptops, desktops, monitors and end-user devices. Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, knowledge articles and support records. Effective communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to a broad range of users. Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service. Advantageous Qualifications or certifications in Information Technology or a related discipline. Experience supporting government, defence or other highly secure environments. Knowledge of ITIL principles and service management practices. Experience with desktop imaging, device provisioning and technical onboarding activities. Exposure to enterprise technologies such as Microsoft 365, VMware, Windows Server, AWS or networking environments. Experience maintaining IT asset registers, software licensing records and hardware inventories. Experience coordinating equipment repairs, warranty claims, vendor engagement and RMA activities. Experience developing user guides, technical documentation and knowledge base content. Experience providing onsite support and working directly with customers to achieve timely resolution of technical issues. Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain an NV2 Security Clearance (PV preferred) and successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment (OSA) . What To Expect When You Apply Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know. Ready to explore what’s possible? If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Ben George, Talent Acquisition. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Original Posting For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. Pay Range The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. About Leidos Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. Pay And Benefits Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits. Securing Your Data Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

review_candidates.location: Skopje, Skopje Statistical Region, North Macedonia
review_candidates.description: Data Analyst and Trainer ABOUT THE JOB As a Data Analyst at Semos Education, you will analyze and interpret complex data to support internal business decision-making. You will develop and maintain data models, ensure data quality, and design reports, dashboards, applications, and other data-driven solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365 CRM, and Azure technologies. In addition to your data analyst responsibilities, the role will also include delivering training sessions in AI and other areas related to your expertise as part of our training programs. No previous training experience is required, as we will support you in gradually developing your skills as a trainer. WHO YOU ARE: Have at least 2+ years of previous experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar role Hands-on experience with Power Platform, and Azure Dynamics 365 CRM Proficient in data modelling, relational databases, and SQL Strong skills in data transformation, filtering, and calculation processes Expertise in creating visualizations and dashboards using Power BI Familiarity with web portals, cloud applications, and other digital solutions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for interacting with stakeholders and team members.     WHAT YOU’LL DO: Requirements & Solution Design Gather and define reporting and solution needs with stakeholders. Propose and align Power Platform-based solutions. Data Management & Analysis Ensure data accuracy through transformation and validation. Perform exploratory analysis to support business decisions. Reporting & Visualization Build and maintain relational data models and measures. Create insightful Power BI dashboards. Deliver internal training on reporting tools. Training & Knowledge Sharing Deliver training sessions in your area of expertise as part of Semos Education’s training programs. Prepare and adapt training materials to provide practical, hands-on learning experiences. Solution Development Define and document requirements for digital solutions. Explore and prototype with Power Platform, Dynamics 365 CRM and Azure tools. Design, test, and implement applications or data science solutions. Ensure post-launch performance and troubleshoot issues. Ongoing Support Maintain and update existing solutions. Create user guides and train teams on new tools.   Please apply on LinkedIn or at: kariera@semos.com.mk We look forward to reviewing your application and exploring the possibility of you joining our team. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.   ABOUT US: At Semos Education you will work with more than 300 creative, smart and good people, on projects that will motivate you to unleash your full potential. Allow us to tell you our story! Semos Education is a leading learning provider in the Western Balkans. We have been setting high-quality standards in the training industry for more than 30 years, providing official training for the world’s largest software companies. Over the years, we have supported the learning of various organizations and individuals, delivering training throughout the SEE region, Northern Europe, and the Middle East. We offer various certified training from different vendors, such as Microsoft, Cisco, Oracle, Java, VMware, EC-Council, ISTQB, Scrum, Adobe, Autodesk, Unity, anad AWS. Aside from official education, we also offer customized training in different information technologies, which include Angular, React, Vue, Go, Python, HTML/CSS, PHP, Programming in C, C++, etc.  Our offices are in Skopje and Belgrade. Semos Education serves as a one-stop shop for IT training, meaning that an organization or individual can find all the courses they need for their professional development. Semos Education is a member of LLPA (Leading Learning Partners Association) a global organization with a presence in more than 55 countries. We share knowledge in: Norway | Sweden | Finland | Denmark | Netherlands | Belgium | Germany | Estonia | Kingdom of Saudi Arabia | Malta | Spain | Italy | Hungary | Poland | Romania | Macedonia | Serbia | Montenegro | Slovenia | Bosnia | Croatia | Bulgaria | Albania | Kosovo
